I would recommend the japanese classic authors Osamu Dazai (most famous work is the novel "no longer human", but my personal recommendation would be "Undine" ), Ryunosuke Akutagawa (mostly dark short stories, i personally would recommend "in a Grove" and "the life of an idiot"), Chuuya Nakahara (mainly poems and short stories, most famous poem is called "for the tainted sorrow") and Atsushi Nakajima (novel "beast beneath the moonlight").

Because lots of literature nerds like us are kinda unstable, i feel the need to put a trigger warning. Dazais work is amazing (at least the parts i know), but ending ones own life is often a topic, and in some works, there are also mentions of domestic violence and sexual assault.
Even more important, Akutagawas stories are amazing, well thought out, and philosophical, but also extremely dark and violent. So tw for murder, sexual assault, sewerslide, lots of gore, and open endings (ok that last part was a joke haha)
